subject: Deployment mode for PHI (HIPAA/BAA) - SOC2 evidence & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: deployment mode for PHI (HIPAA/BAA) - recap & next steps

Hi Priya/Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand Elara's use case. Quick recap from our end and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of needs
- Data type: PHI (patient records + structured claims metadata)
- Compliance: HIPAA + signed BAA required; SOC 2 evidence requested for vendor assessment
- Scale: expected ~100 API requests/sec at peak for routing/triage workflow; typical payloads are moderate (1-2KB)
- Latency SLO: aiming for p95 <200ms
- Region: US (primary in us-east)

Deployment options we discussed
- Hosted API: fastest to launch but limited for PHI unless put behind additional controls; typically we recommend Hosted only for non-PHI or pre-approved BAA customers with restricted data flows
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools with tenant isolation and predictable throughput; supports BAA and is a common choice for regulated PHI workloads
- Private VPC / On-prem: strongest isolation, customer-managed networking and KMS; recommended if you need complete control for audits and on-prem artifacts

Attachments for your review
- redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf (SOC 2 Type II summary)
- redwood-hipaa-summary.docx (HIPAA controls overview + BAA high-level)

Next steps
1) Please confirm whether Elara prefers Dedicated or Private VPC as the initial deployment (we can support a Dedicated first with a migration path to Private later).
2) Share your security contact for legal/BAA procurement (we'll send a draft BAA + SOW).
3) If you can, fill/return the attached Elara questionnaire; we'll start mapping controls.
4) I'll loop in Neha (our Compliance lead) and Dylan (Solutions) to schedule an architecture call — propose Fri 3/5 or Mon 3/8.

If anything above is off, let me know — otherwise we'll action items 2/3 once you confirm contacts.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole

- Deployment preference: we need Dedicated capacity to start. We prefer to keep the option to migrate to Private VPC later in the engagement, but initial production must be on Dedicated.
- Legal/BAA: we will need a signed BAA before any PHI goes into the system. Please send a draft.
- SOC2: yes, please share your SOC 2 Type II report (the document you attached looks relevant; we'll have our Security team review).
- Throughput/latency: 100 req/sec peak with p95 <200ms is what we're budgeting for.
- Onboarding timeline: we'd like an estimate for provisioning Dedicated capacity + integration work. Rough target: 6-8 weeks from SOW sign.

Attached is our completed security questionnaire for the initial mapping: elara_security_qs_filled.pdf

Hi Priya — great, thanks for confirming. Next items from our side and what we'll send this week: 

1) Draft BAA + SOW: attaching BAA-draft-redwood-2026.docx. We'll include a SOW template with estimated MRR for reserved capacity options.
2) SOC 2 evidence: please find redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf attached (overview). Neha will follow up with any artifact requests the Security team needs for deeper review.
3) Architecture call: Dylan, Neha and I can do Fri 3/5 at 10am PT (confirmable). We'll walk through your integration pattern, auth (mTLS / API keys), KMS requirements, and failover/DR expectations.
4) Pricing snapshot: we can provide a rough Reserved (Dedicated) capacity estimate prior to SOW — ballpark ranges based on throughput and model family. We'll include that in the SOW packet.

Notes on deployment choice (short):
- Dedicated capacity provides predictable throughput and supports signed BAA; it's often the sweet spot for customers needing PHI support without full on-prem economics.
- Private VPC/on-prem adds customer-managed networking and KMS; choose this if you need offline audits or specific tooling installed on customer infra.
- Hosted API + BAA is available in limited cases but not our recommended path for sustained PHI processing.

Action items I will take this week:
- Send BAA draft + SOW template (today)
- Share ballpark pricing ranges for Dedicated options (today)
- Confirm architecture call time (Fri 3/5 10am PT)

Priya — can you confirm Angela's email and whether Fri 3/5 10am PT works? Also please indicate any compliance artifacts you need expedited (e.g., encryption key rotation logs, endpoint audit trails).
